label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
scope: First 12 additional items (batch 1). Recipes and declared stats are copied by reference from item-recipes-stats.json and re-checked by validate-items.mjs. Behavior is source inspection only: no probe, no gameplay evidence.

format.label: traced = read through handler and callers; every effect lists the evidence ids it rests on
format.absentVsUntraced: absentEffects = confirmed absence of a handler (checked by git grep in the validator); unresolved = details not traced (not the same as absent)
format.arithmetic: formula applied by hand; not a combat simulation
format.untested: no item was executed or observed in a running game

absentEffects: No ItemEffects entry and no other game-code reference: the only references in app/**/*.ts(x) are the enum/recipe (Item.ts), the declared stats (config/game/items.ts) and a PvE reward list (models/pve-stages.ts:251). Its only gameplay content is the declared +100 AP.
CHOICE_SPECS.statEffect: Declared AP 100 becomes a flat +100 to the entity's AP at fight start (applyStat -> addAbilityPower); ability damage then scales by (1 + AP/100).
arithmetic: Raw ability damage x (1 + 100/100) = x2 from the item's AP alone (before other AP, crit, defense). Not a combat simulation.
unresolved: Nullify Bandanna turns AP gains into Attack; Big Eater/Twist Band modify the stat call (see silk-scarf-items.md).

SOUL_DEW.declaredStatsNote: ItemStats entry exists but is empty: no stat bonus

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: Every 1000 ms of fight time while the holder is updated (first tick after 1000 ms)
effects.effect: +5 AP (addAbilityPower(5, self, 0, false)) and +5 PP (addPP(5, self, 0, false)); tick counter incremented
effects.duration: Whole fight; removal (OnItemRemovedEffect) subtracts 5 x tick count AP
effects.scaling: No AP/crit scaling (apBoost 0). The AP call is subject to Nullify Bandanna (becomes Attack) and Big Eater/Twist Band; the PP call is subject to addPP rules (blocked while silenced/protected/resurrecting/NO_PP_GAIN, halved by fatigue) and Twist Band
effects.limits: No cap seen in the handler (AP floor -100 only)
effects.consumptionOrReset: Not consumed. Resurrection resets count.soulDewCount but recomputes stats from a fresh clone; whether the periodic effect's own tick counter persists after resurrect is not traced.

arithmetic: After 10 s of fight (ms assumed) = 10 ticks: +50 AP and up to +50 PP before PP is spent on casts and ignoring blocked gains. Not a simulation.
unresolved: Time unit of dt (assumed ms, see core-mechanics section C)
Periodic tick counter after resurrection
Declared stats: the ItemStats entry exists but is empty ({}): no stat bonus

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: Every basic attack by the holder (PokemonEntity.onAttack, called from the basic-attack routine only, successful or not)
effects.duration: Whole fight; removal subtracts 5 x upgradeCount
effects.scaling: None (apBoost 0). addSpeed is subject to Big Eater Belt (x1.25 rounded down) and Twist Band
effects.limits: No cap seen in the handler
effects.consumptionOrReset: Not consumed; resurrection resets upgradeCount while stats are recomputed from a clone

arithmetic: 10 basic attacks = +50 speed on top of the declared +10: from the default speed 50, speed 110 gives an attack wait of round(1000/(0.4+0.007*110)) = 855 versus 1333 at speed 50 (nominal, formula from core-mechanics section C). Not a simulation.
unresolved: With Big Eater Belt the per-attack gain is 6 (floor(5*1.25)) but removal subtracts 5 each (inference from the code, untested)

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: When the item is applied to the fight entity (OnItemGainedEffect)
effects.effect: Adds the ABILITY_CRIT effect, which allows the holder's ability casts to roll a crit (chance = critChance/100, one roll per cast). If the holder's ability has canCritByDefault, also +50 crit power
effects.duration: Whole fight (removed again on item removal, reversing the +50 crit power)
effects.scaling: Crit multiplier on ability damage is 1 + (critPower - 1) x reduction (reduction 0 vs Rocky Helmet for non-true damage). Default critPower 2 and critChance 10 plus the declared +20 crit chance
effects.limits: Abilities cast through castAbility with canCrit=false cannot crit; other crit paths not audited

arithmetic: Default crit chance 10 + declared 20 = 30 % per cast (nothing else); crit damage factor 2 at default crit power. Not a simulation.
unresolved: Which abilities pass canCrit=false (not catalogued)
Leek / Large Leek dishes also add ABILITY_CRIT (dishes.ts:128-145); removing the cloth deletes the flag from the effect set whether or not another source added it (untraced interplay)

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: After each ability cast by the holder (OnAbilityCastEffect; runs after the cast's PP spend and cast counter)
effects.effect: +PP: min(maxPP - 10, round(0.2 x maxPP + 2 x number of casts so far, including this one))
effects.scaling: No AP/crit scaling (apBoost 0). addPP rules apply (blocked while silenced/protected/resurrecting/NO_PP_GAIN; fatigue halves; Twist Band)

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: Fight start, only when the holder has the MANAPHY passive
effects.effect: Removes the item from the holder and spawns a Phione on the closest free cell of the holder's team
effects.duration: Once per fight (the item is removed from the fight entity)
effects.consumptionOrReset: Item removed from the fight entity only

arithmetic: maxPP 100: 1st cast +22, 2nd +24, 3rd +26 (round(20 + 2n)), capped at +90. Formula applied by hand, not a simulation.
unresolved: Phione's stats and behavior
Uxie's Hidden Power gives itself an Aqua Egg in code (hidden-power.ts:368); that context was not traced
Declared PP 30 is added to current PP only (never maxPP)

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: Every 3rd basic attack by the holder (counter staticHolderCount incremented in the OnAttack hook, i.e. each basic attack, successful or not)
effects.targets: the up-to-two living enemies closest to the holder (distance sort, may include the attacked target)
effects.effect: 10 raw special damage to each (crit=false, apBoost=false, so no AP or crit scaling; then the normal defense step), and -15 PP each (clamped at 0); manaBurnCount++
effects.duration: Instant, every 3rd attack (counter reset to 0 each time)
effects.scaling: Fixed 10 raw, no AP/crit; defense division by (1 + 0.05 x SPE_DEF) then ceil/min 1 applies (arithmetic from the shared damage path)
effects.limits: Fewer than two living enemies: fewer hits

arithmetic: 10 raw vs SPE_DEF 3: 10 / 1.15 = 8.70 -> 9 each (formula by hand).
otherUse: Kyogre's evolution rule is an item rule on BLUE_ORB (evolves to PRIMAL_KYOGRE): declared at pokemon.ts:6047-6054; acquisition and handler path not traced here.
unresolved: Whether the counter persists across a Max Revive resurrection (not in the reset list read)
Kyogre evolution path
The 10-damage hits go through handleDamage and so can trigger other on-damage-dealt items (Shell Bell, Pokemonomicon) by the shared call path (inference from structure, untested)

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: On a basic attack whose crit roll succeeded (OnAttack hook; also runs on dodged/protected attacks because it keys on the roll, not on damage)
effects.effect: Steals min(target PP, 10): holder addPP(+x), target addPP(-x); manaBurnCount++
effects.scaling: No AP/crit scaling; the holder's gain is subject to addPP rules while the target's loss is applied regardless; Twist Band flips a negative PP change on a Twist Band target
effects.limits: Max 10 PP per crit; none if target has 0 PP

arithmetic: Declared +25 crit chance: 10 default + 25 = 35 % per basic attack; each crit moves up to 10 PP. Not a simulation.
unresolved: Rocky Helmet does not stop it (the hook uses the roll)
Ability casts never trigger it (only the basic attack calls the hook)

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: Whenever the holder deals special-type damage and the target actually takes damage (callback runs when takenDamage > 0, shield absorption included; basic-attack special parts and ability damage)
effects.effect: Burn for 3000 ms (triggerBurn) and -1 SPE_DEF (addSpecialDefense(-1, holder, 0, false))
effects.duration: Burn 3000 ms (reduced by duration reductions, refreshed if longer); SPE_DEF loss is permanent for the fight
effects.scaling: No AP/crit scaling. Burn is blocked by IMMUNITY_BURN, rune protect and the Water Bubble passive; Twist Band on the target flips the debuff; the callback also runs for retaliation damage (isRetaliation is not checked)
effects.limits: SPE_DEF -1 per qualifying hit, no cap seen

arithmetic: Each qualifying hit lowers the target's SPE_DEF by 1: at SPE_DEF 3 to 2, the special damage multiplier goes from 1/1.15 = 0.870 to 1/1.10 = 0.909 (about +4.5 % damage from that point on). Formula only.
unresolved: Burn's per-tick damage and other burn effects (not traced in this batch)
Physical basic attacks do not trigger it; true damage does not trigger it (attackType must be SPECIAL)
Self-damage case (target == holder) not checked

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: Inside handleDamage, when the damage that gets past the shield would leave the holder below 30 % of max HP (hp - residualDamage < 0.3 x maxHP); the check does not require a lethal hit or residual damage > 0
effects.effect: That hit's HP loss is cancelled (takenDamage and residualDamage set to 0, death false), the holder gains +50 PP, gains Protect for 1500 ms, and the item is removed from the fight entity
effects.duration: Protect 1500 ms (not applied if the holder is already protected or enraged)
effects.scaling: PP gain via addPP (rules apply); shield was already reduced for this hit before the check
effects.consumptionOrReset: Consumed for the fight (removeItem, not permanent): the board unit keeps the item for later fights

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: When the item is equipped, or carried through evolution

arithmetic: maxHP 200: a hit leaving HP below 60 triggers it. E.g. HP 70 and 30 residual damage -> 40 < 60 -> the 30 is cancelled. Formula by hand.
unresolved: Because the condition has no 'residual damage > 0' check, a holder already below 30 % whose hit is fully absorbed by shield also triggers it (source reading, untested)
Interaction order with Fossil synergy and resurrection checks that follow
Any gameplay effect of the shiny flag (not traced)

MAX_REVIVE.declaredStatsNote: No ItemStats entry exists for MAX_REVIVE: it declares no stat bonus (entry absent, not zero).

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: Fight start (item applied), then when the holder's HP reaches 0 or below in handleDamage
effects.effect: Grants the resurrection flag at fight start; on HP <= 0 it consumes the flag: holder becomes untargettable and resurrecting for 2000 ms and clears negative statuses; after that resurrect() recomputes stats from a fresh clone (max HP, ATK, DEF, SPE_DEF, AP, speed, crit, dodge, range, luck), sets HP = max HP, PP = 0, shield = 0, resets stack counters (Mach Ribbon, Muscle Band, Soul Dew, Upgrade, Sound Cry), removes MAX_REVIVE from the fight entity, and returns to the moving state with cooldown 0
effects.limits: Not applied to INANIMATE passive units; one revive per item
effects.consumptionOrReset: Consumed for the fight (removed from the entity, board unit keeps it)

unresolved: Death paths that do not go through handleDamage's HP<=0 check (not enumerated)
Exactly which stats the clone restores beyond the ones listed, and which in-fight buffs are therefore lost
Behavior of ally targeting while the holder is untargettable (only noted: enemies targeting it switch to moving)

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: Whenever the holder deals damage (basic attack parts or ability, any damage type; callback runs when the target took damage)
effects.effect: Heals ceil(0.33 x damage actually taken by the target) (shield damage plus HP lost, overkill excluded); skipped when the target is the holder itself
effects.scaling: handleHeal with apBoost 0 and no crit: no AP or crit scaling. handleHeal then gives 0 under wound or protect, x1.3 with BUFF_HEAL_RECEIVED, x0.5 burning, x0.5 enraged, x1.2 Zenith weather, rounds, and caps at missing HP
effects.limits: Capped by missing HP; isRetaliation is not checked

arithmetic: Target takes 100: ceil(0.33 x 100) = 33 heal before the handleHeal modifiers. Formula only.
unresolved: Whether every multi-hit/area ability hit calls the callback exactly once per target (shared path; not enumerated)

effects.label: traced
effects.trigger: Item applied at fight start; checked wherever the listed effects occur
effects.effect: Adds IMMUNITY_LOCKED (the Locked status cannot be applied); canBeMoved is false (forced displacement is refused); board effects are not added to its effect set; ignores the poison-gas, smoke, sticky-web and cotton-ball statuses and the stealth-rocks, spikes, toxic-spikes, hail and ember tick effects
effects.limits: Only the effect checks listed; other displacement or control effects not routed through these checks are untraced

unresolved: Other crowd-control or displacement effects that bypass canBeMoved or the listed checks
Interaction with abilities that move the holder voluntarily (the holder's own movement is not blocked by canBeMoved; only forced displacement)
